import itertools

n = 5
fixed = {2: 3}  # column 2 has row 3

# Generate all permutations of 0..4
solutions = []
for perm in itertools.permutations(range(n)):
    # Check fixed assignment
    ok = True
    for col, row in fixed.items():
        if perm[col] != row:
            ok = False
            break
    if not ok:
        continue
    
    # Check Costas property
    # For all pairs (c1, c2) with c1 < c2, compute (dr, dc) where dr = perm[c2]-perm[c1], dc = c2-c1
    vectors = set()
    valid = True
    for c1 in range(n):
        for c2 in range(c1+1, n):
            dr = perm[c2] - perm[c1]
            dc = c2 - c1
            # dc > 0 always true since c2 > c1
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                valid = False
                break
            vectors.add((dr, dc))
        if not valid:
            break
    if valid:
        solutions.append(list(perm))

print(f"Found {len(solutions)} solutions:")
for sol in solutions:
    print(sol)
